title: camerashake
description: Applies shaking to the players' camera with specified intensity and duration. Parameters: 'stop' or 'add' the effect, specify player (target), intensity (float, min 0.0 to max 4.0), seconds(float, min 0.01), and shakeType (positional or rotational). Must have `Allow Camera Shake` option turned on in user settings.

player.title: player
player.description: A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

intensity.title: intensity
intensity.description: Optional. Default `0.5`. A `float` that specifies the camera shake intensity with values from [0, 4].

seconds.title: seconds
seconds.description: Optional.  A `float` that specifies how long the camera will shake. Default: `1.0`.

shaketype.title: shakeType
shaketype.description: Optional. Either `positional` or `rotational` camera shake type. Default: `positional`.
